description: Three cheating husbands end up paying the price for their infidelities when their spouses hire a private detective – who falls for one of the wives.

When her commoner mother marries the king, average-girl Sofia finds that being a real princess isn't all it's cracked up to be.

titre: It Takes a Man and a Woman
titre_original: It Takes a Man and a Woman

After learning of their son's death on the battlefield, a grieving Berlin couple embark on a quietly dangerous act of resistance against Adolf Hitler.

titre_original: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back

Genius investigator Keith Flick rejoins the royal police force just as serial killer "B" emerges. Mysterious youth Koku may be an ally, or a target.

titre_original: Seben Sours in ze Skurr Castre: Season Frowaa

titre: Forbidden Games: The Justin Fashanu Story
titre_original: Forbidden Games: The Justin Fashanu Story

titre: InuYasha the Movie 2: The Castle Beyond the Looking Glass
titre_original: InuYasha ze Mobie 2: Ze Castre Beyond ze Rooking Grass
description: With their biggest foe seemingly defeated, InuYasha and his friends return to everyday life. But the peace is soon shattered by an emerging new enemy.
A young woman faces pressure to marry her brother-in-law, after her sister dies while giving birth. But she's secretly in love with someone else.
Two mismatched archaeologists battle a team of vicious mercenaries in a race to discover an ancient Tibetan treasure of unimaginable worth.

Legendary gamer siblings Sora and Shiro are transported to a world where life is a series of games and humanity is in grave danger of extinction.
The CIA attempts to turn Ted Kaczynski, aka the Unabomber, into a super agent — a plan that backfires. Based on real events.

titre: Alan Saldaña: Mi vida de pobre
titre_original: Alan Saldaña: Mi vida de pobre
description: Mexican comic Alan Saldaña has fun with everything from the pressure of sitting in an exit row to maxing out his credit card in this stand-up special.

titre: The Magic School Bus Rides Again Kids In Space
titre_original: The Magic School Bus Rides Again Kids In Space

This reality series follows elite professional lifeguards on Sydney's Bondi Beach, as they take on everything from animal stings to criminals.

Four girls summon their inner superheroes to defend Earth and the magical kingdom of Splendorius from King Mercenare and his minions.

Due to an error, self-absorbed Eleanor Shellstrop arrives at the Good Place after her death. Determined to stay, she tries to become a better person.

titre: Lo and Behold: Reveries of the Connected World
titre_original: Lo and Behold: Reveries of the Connected World
description: Filmmaker Werner Herzog presents a history of the internet, starting with its birth in 1969, and ponders the joys and sorrows of its social influence.
A serial killer picks off a group of friends, one by one, as they make their way through a hell-themed amusement park.

titre: To All the Boys: Always and Forever - The Afterparty
titre_original: To All the Boys: Always and Forever - The Afterparty
description: Cast members of the "To All the Boys" films dish about the third movie and answer some fan questions, plus Whitney Cummings gives suspect dating advice.
While strange rumors about their ill king grip a kingdom, the crown prince becomes their only hope against a mysterious plague overtaking the land.

titre: Motu Patlu the Superheroes – Super Villains from Mars
titre_original: Motu Patlu the Superheroes – Super Villains from Mars
description: Friends Motu and Patlu must save the world from three space thieves, but the job gets much harder when a cosmic collision gives the enemies superpowers!

Strapped for cash, a traveling projectionist begins to run a DVD pirating business, putting him at odds with his young, skeptical son.

titre: Club de Cuervos Presents: The Ballad of Hugo Sánchez
titre_original: Club de Cuervos Presents: The Ballad of Hugo Sánchez

When three different boys propose to a lively, strictly reared girl who yearns to be a performer, she agrees to marry the winner of a singing contest.
At their high school, a group of unruly teens wreak havoc, face bullies and navigate turbulent lives beyond school grounds.

titre: Kuldip Patwal: I Didn't Do It!
titre_original: Kuldip Patwal: I Didn't Do It!

titre: Spirit Riding Free: Ride Along Adventure
titre_original: Spirit Riding Free: Ride Along Adventure
description: Join Lucky and her friends on an interactive mission to save Maricela’s beloved mare from greedy horse thieves who've taken her captive with a wild herd.

Time passes and tension mounts in a Florida police station as an estranged interracial couple awaits news of their missing teenage son.

Known for tortuous role-play with victims in his basement, a twisted serial killer abducts a musician who has a deeper connection to his mind games.
Follow the outrageous, high-octane adventures of Buddy Thunderstruck, a truck-racing dog who brings guts and good times to the town of Greasepit.
While vacationing at a remote lake house, a mother and her daughters become pawns in the twisted game of an ax-wielding psychopath.
Pushing 40 and unemployed, a Dubai returnee desperate for a wife catches the eye of a Bhopal belle, who sees him solely as her ticket out of India.

titre: Lupin the 3rd: The Castle of Cagliostro: Special Edition
titre_original: Rupin ze 3rd: Ze Castre of Cagriostro: Speciar Edishon

titre_original: Martin Matte: La vie, la mort...eh la la..!

A newspaper seller bemoans his lack of success but is undermined by his own laziness when he gets a better job as a driver and finds his rich father.
As he reconciles with his ex and their son, an enforcer for a crime family gets an order that tests his loyalty and endangers everyone he holds dear.
Former mobster Henry Hill recounts his colorful yet violent rise and fall in a New York crime family – a high-rolling dream turned paranoid nightmare.

titre: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
titre_original: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
description: Shaun and the flock race to help an adorable alien find her way home after her ship crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm and sparks a UFO frenzy.

titre_original: You Don't Mess with the Zohan
description: An Israeli counterterrorism soldier with a secretly fabulous ambition to become a Manhattan hairstylist will do anything to make his dreams come true.

A young married couple tries to save their disintegrating relationship by turning their fights into songs, with the help of an oddball neighbor.
Decades after the assassination of African American leader Malcolm X, an activist embarks on a complex mission seeking truth in the name of justice.
As controversy surrounds the evangelical church he helped found, Edir Macedo must juggle betrayals, politics and personal loss in this biopic sequel.
After discovering his estranged daughter's link to mysterious murders, a forensic detective with Asperger's syndrome risks everything to solve the case.
Finding a tantalizing clue in an old letter, a young woman journeys to her family's tropical plantation to uncover generations of secrets.

His hilltop farm in Vermont may be bucolic, but making ends meet is a backbreaking challenge for grizzled, hard-drinking organic farmer Peter Dunning.
An intelligent but intense honor student traumatizes his high school teacher and mentor when he doesn't get the grade he believes he deserves.
Rich kid Payton has always known he's going to be president. But first he has to navigate the most treacherous political landscape of all: high school.
Arrested in Rome for a drug-related offense, Stefano Cucchi endures a harrowing week in custody that changes his family forever. Based on true events.

titre_original: Who the F**k Is That Guy?

In 19th-century Istanbul, a young police officer investigates crimes and falls in love with the daughter of a wealthy merchant conspiring against him.

Agam Singh's brothers mean everything to him, so while he promises not to marry, he tries to get them to marry – but they want him to marry first.
Soon after relocating to Southeast Asia, an American family lands in the midst of a violent coup that could cost them their lives.
After a young boy is murdered in the small seaside town of Broadchurch, local detectives Ellie Miller and Alec Hardy are assigned the mysterious case.
Amid growing tensions in their marriage, a Johannesburg professor and his journalist wife find their lives upended by a famous, hard-partying author.
When her former lover's mysteriously murdered, a woman must clear her name – and avoid the killer.
When Pakistani authorities learn of a looming terrorist strike, they ask a retired intelligence officer to counter the attack before it's too late.

During a wilderness getaway, a gang of sociopathic criminals kidnap a woman and assault her husband, who must summon all his strength to save her.

A top student gets pulled into a cheating racket with increasingly higher risks and even higher rewards. But she may lose much more than she gains.
After a failed heist leads to a stint behind bars, a group of men reenters society with a risky business plan that soon reveals their true colors.

Two doctors with opposite approaches to treating patients clash on the job and must learn to trust each other's expertise, allowing love to bloom.
A happy secret romance between a 40-year-old woman and a 25-year-old man is complicated after a greeting card grants her wish to be young again.
Wayward Prince Hal must turn from carouser to warrior king as he faces hostilities from inside and outside the castle walls in the battle for England.
An overconfident teen bets he can make a homely transfer student fall in love with him in 30 days — but the wager starts to play games with his heart.
A blind woman with vices finds herself in the middle of a murder investigation when her best friend turns up dead.
A couple and their young daughter are haunted by a paranormal, malicious presence – which is soon linked to a temple and a series of abortions.
Follow the adventure of four young transformers, Heatwave, Chase, Blades and Boulder, and their human counterparts: a family of emergency responders.

A 30-something woman without a steady partner or income samples stability when her pregnant best friend asks her to be the godmother of her child.
When the son of a wealthy businessman and the daughter of a struggling engineer fall in love, the young man's parents question the girl's motives.

An unlucky, debt-ridden teen resorts to his math skills when he's forced into a deadly tournament of rock-paper-scissors run by a diabolical host.
When he gets a fan letter from a young monster movie buff, Dracula visits him and soon has a new friend helping him to get his confidence back.
Two rebellious, hot-headed teenage brothers get caught up in gang life, which has dangerous repercussions for their family and friends.
Up against a corrupt government official and crushing poverty, a young boy in the Delhi slums attempts to raise funds to build himself his own toilet.
Along with her son and best friend, a grieving widow hikes into the woods to scatter her late husband's ashes, only to discover they're being stalked.

titre: Once In A Lifetime Sessions with TLC
titre_original: Once In A Lifetime Sessions with TLC
description: One of the most successful female groups in music history, TLC performs in concert while taking a look back at their tumultuous history.
A British juvenile offender's violent temper gets him transferred to an adult prison, where he encounters his estranged father.

A struggling comedian returns to Austin, Texas, to see her ailing cat and face her messy past – while staying with her ex and his new girlfriend.
A dying kung fu master sends his last student to track down five former pupils in order to learn which one of them has become evil.
When she loses her beloved husband to a brain tumor, grieving widow Holly Kennedy learns that he left a series of letters behind to help her cope.
Silvia Broome is a translator at the United Nations. But her job turns perilous when she overhears a plot to assassinate a government official.
From the mind of comedian Iliza Shlesinger comes a fun, irreverent mix of kooky characters, sly social commentary and pop culture gags.
A troubled divorcée fixates on a seemingly ideal couple from afar until a shocking observation sends her spiraling straight into a knotty murder case.
A food-blogging insurance agent encounters a friend from elementary school with a vendetta against him — but soon becomes her sidekick.
Comedian Hans Teeuwen rebels against political correctness, proclaims himself Britain's moral leader and takes on Donald Trump.

A hard-partying heir dons a disguise to fight crime after hours. But with no talents or skills, he relies on his friend, a martial-arts genius.
In a peaceful, rustic town, a retired officer and his family are mired in a murder mystery riddled with shocking, buried secrets.
A high school senior sets out to make a no-budget horror film with his friend, one-time rival and teacher, but the project soon jeopardizes their future.
A Catalán prisoner at a Nazi concentration camp uses his office job to steal photo negatives of the atrocities committed there. Based on true events.

After a traumatic incident at a party makes her a target of gossip and derision, a young college student tries to change her school's toxic culture.

This fictionalized account of three real-life notorious Harlem drug dealers is told in flashbacks as they plunge into the world of hustling.

titre: Luccas Neto in: The End of Christmas
titre_original: Luccas Neto in: Te End of Cristmas
description: To save Christmas, Luccas and Gi head to the North Pole and are recruited by Santa Claus to find all the gifts that have mysteriously disappeared.

titre_original: Chhota Bheem & Krishna: Pataliputra- City of the Dead
description: Krishna needs Bheem’s help: The ruined city of Pataliputra has been cursed! Can the friends do what it takes to bring light back into this town?

titre: Story of Kale: When Someone's in Love
titre_original: Story of Kale: When Someone's in Lofe
description: After leaving a toxic relationship, Dinda embarks on a romance with Kale, whose view on love soon shatters as he wrestles with his own insecurities.

titre: I'll See You in My Dreams

description: After the passing of her dog, a long-widowed senior citizen is in need of companionship. Two very different possibilities present themselves.

The right to vote is at the foundation of America's democracy. But not every vote is created equal. How does the system work, and can it be fixed?

titre: The Rift: The Dark Side of the Moon
titre_original: Te Rift: Te Dark Side of te Moon
description: When a team of special agents is sent to recover the wreckage of a downed satellite in Serbia, their mission takes a horrifying turn.
As a woman scours Hyderabad for her missing husband, she becomes entangled in a conspiracy that suggests there’s more to the mystery than meets the eye.
Outcast from society and left to die in the wilderness, a young boy with polio embarks on a journey to connect with his mother. Based on a true story.
Dispatched to a small Italian town to await further orders, assassin Jack embarks on a double life that may be more relaxing than is good for him.
Unaware they’ve matched online, a struggling writer embellishes his lifestyle to impress a successful exec with whom he sparks an unexpected romance.
In 1985, when a vessel protesting nuclear testing is sunk in New Zealand, local police fight to prove it was a terrorist plot by their French allies.
After many years away, a woman returns to her hometown, where her mayor father presides over a corrupt, lawless and rundown municipality.
Cookie, Pudding and Candy are kitten siblings whose favorite things are sweet treats and letting their curiosity lead them on adventures in learning.
In three stories set in Northeast India, a child goes on the run, a young adult falls in with the wrong crowd and a desperate man turns to crime.
Six teens invited to attend a state-of-the-art adventure camp on Isla Nublar must band together to survive when the dinosaurs break out of captivity.
The holiday season is ruined for Santa Claus when his cranky older brother – a repo man with a sizable rap sheet – visits him at the North Pole.
Besieged by overwhelming enemy forces, Irish soldiers on a U.N. peacekeeping mission in Africa valiantly defend their outpost in this true story.
After their mother's death, four sisters learn a shocking family secret and embark on an adventure to discover the truth about their genealogy.
Problems big and small pop up when Scott Lang, aka Ant-Man, gets drafted by Dr. Hank Pym and Hope van Dyne, aka the Wasp, for an urgent rescue mission.
Armed with a key that allows them to morph into any team of Legendary Rangers from the past, the Super Megaforce Rangers fight ruthless Prince Vekar.
Challenged to compose 100 songs before he can marry the girl he loves, a tortured but passionate singer-songwriter embarks on a poignant musical journey.

titre: American Factory: A Conversation with the Obamas
titre_original: American Factory: A Conversation with the Obamas
description: Barack and Michelle Obama talk with directors Steven Bognar and Julia Reichert about the documentary and the importance of storytelling.
Journalists and fans await Ma Anand Sheela as the infamous former Rajneesh commune’s spokesperson returns to India after decades for an interview tour.

titre: Treasures from the Wreck of the Unbelievable
titre_original: Treasures from the Wreck of the Unbelievable
description: This cinematic journey into the waters off East Africa chronicles the story behind artist Damien Hirst's massive exhibition of oceanic treasures.
Two corporate spies with a $5 million haul for selling secrets are held hostage by a thief, triggering a game of cat and mouse to gain the upper hand.
A veteran cop forms an agency dedicated to solving cold cases, including those related to the team members' own painful and mysterious pasts.
After his brother dies in a car crash, a disgraced MMA fighter takes over the family nightclub — and soon learns his sibling's death wasn’t an accident.
This riveting series follows three star high school quarterbacks as they play their final season before moving on to Division I college football.
A talented teen implicated in a robbery-turned-murder fights for his innocence and integrity against a criminal justice system that’s already judged him.
This offbeat drama charts the ups and downs of an interracial lesbian couple and their multiethnic brood of biological, adopted and foster children.
A present-day woman takes responsibility for guiding a charming time-traveling 19th-century nobleman through the 21st century.
Male celebs play make-believe as high schoolers, welcoming star transfer students every week and engaging in battles of witty humor and slapstick.
A trio of siblings gets trapped in a secret temple, where they must navigate a risky obstacle course to make it out. Inspired by the ‘90s game show.
Returning for a second Netflix comedy special, Jim Jefferies unleashes his famously ferocious black humor to a packed house in Nashville, Tennessee.
Uprooted to America, an aspiring Indian entrepreneur confronts disapproval, sexism and rivalry as she draws from her culture to start a tea business.
Dreaming her whole life of becoming a pilot, Yolanda finds work as a flight attendant, unaware she'll soon be thrust into a drug smuggling operation.
After hitting the skids in her career, an aspiring country singer finds new life as a nanny for a handsome widower and his five charming children.
Sir David Attenborough examines a recently discovered collection of dinosaur fossils. CGI and 3-D scans reveal what the beast may have looked like.
It's 1979, and engineer Sami is excited to leave his Indian village for a job in Chicago. But he soon runs into problems achieving his American dream.
At an apartment complex, the lives of a mother, a daughter seeking an arranged marriage, a military retiree and a young man become intertwined.
This deftly animated take on a legendary Old English epic tells the timeless tale of a Scandinavian hero who's known for slaying dragons.
A would-be writer lands a job as a croupier to make ends meet. But when he becomes involved with a gambler, he is lured into taking part in a heist.
Manipulated into embezzling funds for her boyfriend and sentenced to prison, a naïve young woman must quickly learn to survive in a harsh new world.
With his parents and all 10 sisters in tow, Lincoln Loud heads to Scotland and learns that royalty runs in the family in this global musical journey!
Learn letters, numbers, animal sounds and more with J.J. in this edutaining series that brings fun times with nursery rhymes for the whole family!
The complex historical figure of Leon Trotsky comes to life in this epic biography that depicts the tumultuous life of the Russian revolutionary.
Visitors arrive from space to help Red Ranger and his squad – temporarily stripped of their powers – fight against Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa.

titre: From One Second to the Next
titre_original: From One Second to the Next
description: Werner Herzog chronicles the devastating consequences of texting and driving. The film examines how lives can be forever altered by a trivial text.
Confined to her home by agoraphobia, a psychologist becomes obsessed with her new neighbors — and solving a brutal crime she witnesses from her window.
When a prep school loner films two classmates overdosing on cocaine, his footage plays a role in the emotional fallout within the school community.
Two teen cricket prodigies struggle against their overbearing father and a system stacked against them to realize their own ambitions and identities.
While searching for her ex-boyfriend, a young drifter impulsively kidnaps a baby from a neglectful mother and pretends the child is her own.
Now that he's discovered the Pendulum Summoning technique, Yuya's dream of becoming the greatest "dueltainer" is in reach – but it won't be easy!
Ten years after John Connor saved Earth from Judgment Day, he encounters T-X, a robotic assassin ordered to finish what T-1000 started.
Once upon a time, baseball cards were as much an American pastime as the sport. But then scandal rocked the multi-million-dollar industry for good.

titre: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
titre_original: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
description: After being falsely imprisoned, a vengeful murderer covers his tracks by enlisting the help of a baker whose meat pies become the toast of London.
A hoodie-wearing, unbreakable ex-con fights to clear his name and save his neighborhood. He wasn't looking for a fight, but the people need a hero.

titre: Churchill’s Secret Agents: The New Recruits
titre_original: Churchill’s Secret Agents: The New Recruits
description: In this history-steeped reality series, 14 contestants undergo the same rigorous four-day selection process as Britain's top-secret World War II spies.
A young woman conducts a search for her twin sister, who disappeared in a notorious area of Japan known as the Suicide Forest.

The lives of a middle-aged soap opera addict, an ambitious career woman, a fervent activist and nine others from different walks of Indian life intersect in Mumbai. But this vibrant melting pot threatens to bubble over with bias and bigotry.
A pair of young environmentalists enlist the help of an ex-military explosives expert to carry out a dangerous act of eco-terrorism.
After igniting a Twitter war with a well-known culinary critic, a Los Angeles chef packs his knives, heads home to Miami and opens a food truck.
Individually, bank employees Sanjay and Karina don't earn enough to be able to buy a home, so they decide to enter into a marriage of convenience.
Rushing to pay off a loan shark, a young man breaks into a bungalow to steal the cash, unprepared for the dog standing guard – or the trouble inside.
Elisabeth and John-John live in the same city, but they inhabit different worlds. Can a passionate first love break through class and cultural barriers?
In this intimate documentary, former Uruguayan President José "Pepe" Mujica talks about lessons he learned while in prison, his ideals and the future.
Raised in the privileged bubble of Delhi's elite, a teen is compelled to question his outlook on life and love when his older brother comes out as gay.
When a prominent politician is murdered, the intrepid journalists of Frente Tijuana risk their lives to uncover the truth.

titre: Sleepless Society: Two Pillows & A Lost Soul
titre_original: Sleepless Society: Two Pillows & A Lost Soul
description: A motivational speaker about to divorce her abusive husband wakes up from a wild party one morning to find a dead body.
A filmmaker forges an unusual friendship with an octopus living in a South African kelp forest, learning as the animal shares the mysteries of her world.
After his son's tragic death, a Louisiana pharmacist goes to extremes to expose the rampant corruption behind the opioid addiction crisis.
Join historian Dan Jones on a journey back in time to the zenith of Britain's most iconic structures and their infamous inhabitants.
A pregnant teen is forced by her family to leave her boyfriend and assume a new identity in America, but 12 years later, the couple reunites in Korea.
While running from the law, Sayed begins to work as a house servant to a wealthy family, whose divorced daughter enlists his help in a marriage scheme.
This docuseries celebrates the virtual collaborations between a group of artists, dancers and writers from around the world during the pandemic.
A fascinating character. Exquisite sets. A wig for every era. The stars, creators and crew reveal how the hit series about a chess prodigy came to life.
Facing a drought, a hungry tiger and a noble cow have an extraordinary encounter in this fable based on a children’s book and a Kannada folk song.
Two sisters discover disturbing family secrets after a string of mysterious deaths occur on a luxury ship traveling from Spain to Brazil in the 1940s.
While investigating a brutal string of deaths, a detective begins to suspect that mind control may have played a part in the murders.

titre: ChuChuTV Bedtime Stories & Moral Stories for Kids (Hindi)
titre_original: ChuChuTV Bedtime Stories & Moral Stories for Kids (Hindi)
description: In this collection of stories, ChuChu and her pals meet a man in need, Chiku must change a bad habit and ChaCha gets a lesson in management.
A Chinese pharmaceutical lawyer framed for a vile crime teams up with a sharp-witted Japanese detective to stop a dangerous corporate plot.
An occupying Japanese general challenges Chinese men to duels to prove the superiority of the Japanese, but Ip Man refuses to fight – at first.
A fiery young woman accepts help from a spy agency to avenge her lover's murder. In return, she must prove herself as one of their top recruits.
An aimless gamer and his two friends find themselves in a parallel Tokyo, where they're forced to compete in a series of sadistic games to survive.
When a teen accidentally discovers an enchanted realm, she becomes the only one able to unite the human and magical worlds – and save both from evil.
In the first-ever competitive cannabis cooking show, two chefs prepare mouthwatering marijuana-infused dishes for a panel of very chill celeb judges.
A loving, concerned American grandson travels to Mumbai to rescue his unappreciated grandmother from her drudgery and fulfill her true potential.
Three young, aspiring Indian rappers make their way in a cutthroat music industry, dreaming of fame, stardom and ultimate hip-hop domination .
When her little sister claims she sees the dead, Alia consults a psychic, who opens her own eyes to the vengeful ghosts haunting their childhood home.
A group of college students on a weekend getaway accidentally summon a supernatural entity intent on using them for its deadly ritual.
